items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 17 May 2026 7:32am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Sunday, 17 May 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Dry and fairly bright this morning with some hazy sunshine at times, then occasional showers this afternoon which may merge into a longer spell of rain this evening. Moderate to fresh westerly wind, slowly backing southwest before decreasing later. Maximum temperature 13°C.

Mostly dry with bright or sunny spells tomorrow, then cloud increasing late afternoon ahead of an area of rain late evening and overnight into Tuesday. Light to moderate southwest wind backing southeast later , then strengthening. Top temperature 13°C.


##Outlook##

Outbreaks of rain to start on Tuesday, clearing to showers and bright intervals. Fresh to strong southeast wind veering southwest and decreasing later. Highest temperature 14°C.
